segments.text: SINGAPORE: Oil prices rose slightly on Friday and are on track to snap a three-week losing streak as ongoing attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz and Saudi energy infrastructure heightened concerns over oil supply from the conflict-hi
Brent crude futures rose 4 cents to $96.61 a barrel by 0450 GMT, after gaining nearly $2 on Thursday to settle at their highest since November 6.
US West Texas Intermediate crude futures were at $85.78 a barrel, up $2.10, or 2.5%, from their close on Wednesday.

newsDocuments.headline: Customs seizes boat carrying 40,000 smuggled diesel

segments.text: KARACHI: Pakistan Customs’ Marine Enforcement Unit in Gwadar has seized a boat carrying 40,000 liters of smuggled high-speed diesel off the Balochistan coast. Customs valued the seizure, along with the boat, at around Rs40 million.
Officials said the unit acted on intelligence about fuel being smuggled by sea. It tracked and pursued the vessel for more than 72 hours through rough sea conditions before intercepting it.
